per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must respond to user interactions within 5 seconds to be considered fast and avoid user frustration.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The maximum wait time for a user navigating from one screen to another within the Disputes application shall be no more than 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must be available during all operational hours, with planned maintenance windows limited to specific early morning hours.
The system must integrate with existing identity providers using SAML or OIDC and enforce multi-factor authentication for external partners.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall ensure that only authorized users are allowed to logon to the application.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must provide role-based access control and row-level security to ensure that users can only access data they are authorized to see.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes System must prevent users from accessing any dispute cases that do not belong to their cardholder base.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must maintain immutable audit logs that record every meaningful user action, including actor identity, timestamp, action type, and state changes.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application must maintain a detailed history of every action that a user takes on a dispute case. This ensures a complete audit trail if questions arise later on with regard to a particular dispute case.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must be designed to be horizontally scalable and use message queues and worker pools to handle peak loads and backpressure.

per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Statement Database. The Statement Database provides the transaction details to the Disputes System. All transaction details must be obtained from the Statement Database'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must provide clear status information to users when actions are queued or pending, including correlation IDs and estimated times for retries.
